recommended.variant: Native details/summary; exclusive groups use details name. The summary keeps native open/expanded behavior without manually duplicating aria-expanded.

entries.behavior: HTML defines details as a disclosure widget, summary activation, open state, and exclusive groups through details name; this is the native contract selected by the architecture.
entries.decision: Use details/summary and details name for exclusive groups; do not replace it with the ARIA-button variant without an architecture change.

entries.behavior: CANDIDATE Disclosure of Answers to FAQ report: 89 MUST assertions passed and 4 failed; no negative side effects. This is the ARIA-button comparison baseline, not a details/summary measurement. MUST counts exclude ARIA-AT's per-command negative-side-effect assertions; side effects are reported separately.
entries.source_date: results completed through 2025-11-02; test plan V25.11.04
entries.decision: Keep details/summary and separately assess its native-matrix results; do not transfer the button result as native certification.

This is the ARIA-button comparison baseline. MUST counts exclude ARIA-AT's per-command negative-side-effect assertions; side effects are reported separately.

entries.decision: Run the real VoiceOver lane against details/summary rather than assuming the button result transfers.

entries.behavior: The historical summary matrix supports name, role, expanded state, and changed expanded state on TalkBack/Chrome; details role is also supported. Results are old and do not certify current TalkBack.
entries.decision: Retain native details/summary for TalkBack while preserving current implementation QA.

entries.behavior: The historical summary matrix reports no support for summary role, expanded state, or changed expanded state on VoiceOver iOS; details role itself is supported. This is a dated degradation, not a current all-task blocker.
entries.decision: Keep the native candidate but require a current real-iOS test before claiming expanded-state support.

entries.at_version: iOS versions in historical WebKit report
entries.behavior: WebKit 162041 documents the original absence of iOS details accessibility, including missing expanded/collapsed state. It is historical evidence behind the later support matrix, not proof of a current unfixed defect.
entries.decision: Do not cite the 2016 report as a permanent blocker; retest current iOS details/summary.

entries.behavior: Chromium 558324 documents a historical incorrect details expanded state in the accessibility tree. It supplies tracker context for old NVDA matrix failures, not a current support claim.
entries.decision: Retain native details but verify changed-state output rather than relying on the DOM open attribute alone.

entries.behavior: a11ysupport details-summary test: NVDA 2021.1 fails the changed expanded state on Chrome and Edge and passes it on Firefox. Results are old and do not certify current NVDA.
entries.decision: Keep native details/summary; the NVDA changed-state gap is a dated degraded observation, so changed-state output is verified by test rather than assumed.
